opening.argument: The speaker presents an account-based cryptocurrency opportunity in which artificial intelligence performs the trading, stating that it is “a force Opportunity where they do all the trading for you with this AI artificial intelligence.” The opportunity is also structured around recruitment and funded team placement rather than independently verified trading results: he describes a 103-member organization with direct referrals on left and right teams, then explains that placing a $100-funded person on each side can qualify him for binary income. Those conditions, together with the reported account increase and suggestion that adding more money could produce very good returns, present a compelling returns-based opportunity while leaving the results unindependently verified. The account, referral, team, and bonus structure therefore supports the asserted trading-bot or funded-contract-return concern.
